article.story: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. -- — Titas Sargiunas scored 22 points as Lipscomb beat Marshall 90-67 on Wednesday. Sargiunas added five rebounds for the Bisons (3-4). Grant Asman scored 18 points and added six rebounds. Ethan Duncan went 6 of 11 from the field (3 for 5 from 3-point range) to finish with 17 points, while adding three steals. The Thundering Herd (5-2) were led in scoring by Noah Otshudi, who finished with 18 points, four assists and two steals. Wyatt Fricks added 16 points for Marshall. Up next Lipscomb plays Saturday against Southeast Missouri State on the road, and Marshall visits UNC Wilmington on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
